title: The cockpit function registry (issue #565, RC-10 of EPIC #551)
description: The one declaration of every cockpit function: the operator-typed mnemonic, the API endpoint(s) it binds to, its parameters, the identity/rbac scope it needs, its effect class, its stream and its role suitability. Closed sets that this registry CONSUMES rather than restates: the effect classes and the command capabilities come from control-plane/control/verbs.yaml (RC-2), the surfaces and their declared routes from infra/feature-flags/registry.yaml, and the permissions a panel may cite from identity/rbac. A function outside this file does not exist; a verb or surface outside it is either declared here or excused by name in `undeclared`.

consumes.description: The declared authorities this registry reads and never restates.

vocabulary.description: RC-2's control-verb vocabulary: the closed effect classes, and each command's capability and audit action.

surfaces.description: The feature-flag registry: which surfaces exist, and the routes each surface declares for itself.

permissions.description: identity/rbac's permission language: a panel may cite a permission identity/rbac declares, never mint one.

roles.description: The closed role set. A role is a RECOMMENDATION lens over the one function set (ADR-0026 D8/D9): it narrows what is shown, and never grants permission.

parameter_types.description: The closed parameter type set. Every declared parameter carries one of these.

undeclared.description: A verb or surface that is deliberately NOT a cockpit function, with the reason. Nothing is silently dropped: an exposed verb or a declared surface that is neither declared above nor named here fails the gate.

id.description: The operator-typed mnemonic: short, uppercase, unambiguous, unique in this file.

route.description: The API route. For a command this must be exactly RC-3's route for the verb it names; for a panel or view it must be a route the surface's own declaration names.

verb.description: The RC-2 verb id this endpoint commands. Exactly one of `verb` / `surface` is present.

surface.description: The feature-flag surface key this endpoint reads. Exactly one of `verb` / `surface` is present.

parameters.description: This function's own closed parameter set. Closed by name: a parameter a caller sends that is not declared here is refused, naming it.

capability.description: The identity/rbac capability the CALLER must hold. For a command this must be exactly RC-2's capability for its verb. null means the surface is served to any authenticated principal, and then why_no_capability is required.

effect_class.description: RC-2's blast-radius vocabulary, consumed from the vocabulary this registry declares in `consumes.vocabulary` and never restated here. For a command it must equal the verb's own class.

audit.description: The action recorded on the existing rails: null for a read, required for hold/stop/irreversible.

stream.description: The surface whose live stream this function subscribes to. Required for a `view`, null otherwise.

roles.description: The roles this function is DESIGNED FOR — a recommendation for additive filtering. Additive only: it can never permit a call; permission stays with identity/rbac.
